interface.longDescription: FAKE by objekts authors fictional adult characters with real Google GNM head geometry, connected facial controls, Russian and English UI, versioned Character State and explicit Identity Master selection. Structured brief suggestions can initialize editable morphology; an extended range gives stronger changes while older projects retain their original calculation. Local photo fitting provides an approximate starting point. Studio transfers actual geometry and selected reference images through supported MCP Apps or ChatGPT paths, then requests a photorealistic portrait from the conversation image generator. No user API key or separate paid image API is required. Generation runs in the conversation; availability depends on its host, and exact likeness or geometry preservation is not guaranteed. Age and tissue appearance includes generation guidance. Master import remains explicit. Created by objekts — a visual production studio creating films, images and visual worlds through direction, AI production, VFX and animation, from first idea to final frame. Barcelona / Moscow / Worldwide. https://objekts.ai/

positive.prompt: Create a deliberately non-generic 62-year-old fictional adult with deep-set eyes, a long convex nose, broad mouth, heavy lower face and mild asymmetry. Open FAKE by objekts so I can refine the anatomy before generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the actual Studio with the requested description and optional valid structured morphologySeed suggestions. Show the real GNM result for review. Keep inferred shape suggestions distinct from measured likeness and never invent raw GNM vectors or claim a generated photograph before an actual image appears.

positive.prompt: Open FAKE by objekts so I can fit an adult portrait reference and then adjust cheek fullness, orbital depth and jaw weight without losing the source identity.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_character_studio and open Studio. The app performs local landmark detection and GNM fitting after the user provides a photo; the assistant must not invent fit metrics, coefficients or a successful fit before the app reports them.

positive.description: Geometry-to-portrait handoff. In a compatible image-enabled host, open the character, review the actual mesh, save it, then press Generate Portrait in Studio. This case is blocked if the host cannot generate images.
positive.prompt: Create a fictional adult with a long midface, narrow eyes and a broad jaw. Let me inspect the head in FAKE, then generate one neutral photographic portrait after I approve the shape.
positive.tools_triggered: open_character_studio; read_portrait_request only when Studio supplies a real server-ticket follow-up
positive.expected_behavior: Open the actual Studio and preserve the authored description. After the reviewer saves and presses Generate Portrait, transfer the actual saved geometry and available references. If the server-ticket route is used, read_portrait_request must return real image content for the supplied requestId and requestToken. Use the conversation image tool when available and return its actual image. A transfer acknowledgment, prompt or geometry screenshot is not a generated portrait. If generation is unavailable or rejected, report that limit without claiming completion.

positive.description: Explicit Identity Master reuse in the same Studio session. First complete the portrait case. Save the actual generated PNG/JPEG/WebP below 4 MB, select it in STATE and explicitly approve it as Master. Change capture to profile and save before the second generation.
positive.prompt: Keep the approved character and make a profile portrait with the same face and skin. Preserve the saved Identity Master; change only the camera view.
positive.tools_triggered: read_portrait_request only when Studio supplies a real server-ticket follow-up; no new project creation for an existing Studio session
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the existing project and explicit Master. Studio must retain its identityMasterOutputId after the capture edit and include that Master before the geometry reference on the next generation request. On the server-ticket route, read_portrait_request returns both real image inputs at the saved revision. The conversation image tool must return an actual profile portrait before success is claimed. Never claim automatic image import, exact likeness or successful Master storage without app evidence. If the initial image or host capability is unavailable, record this case as blocked.
